originality.rationale: No checked primary-source theorem or comparable indexed scientific claim implies the exact finite cyclic periodization spectrum, all-N rank formula, even-odd sharp strict-positive-definiteness criterion or scale-resolved first-band-wrap crossover. The motivating Toeplitz paper proves a different asymptotic quantile theorem; classic B-spline and circulant facts are used as ingredients and not claimed as innovations. Residual risk: a historical wrapped-spline/cyclic-covariance theorem not indexed by the searched sources may exist.
residual_risks: A historical but unindexed wrapped B-spline circulant calculation may already imply this exact theorem.

The general circulant result plus the standard B-spline identity makes this theorem relatively elementary algebraically; its value is the complete sharp, parity-sensitive phase boundary, not those ingredients.
Independent source-by-source validation remains to be performed.

value.rationale: A natural infinite family of cyclic signal-covariance matrices admits a complete finite-size sharp stable-versus-singular criterion and a parity-sensitive Nyquist crossover. All p and N are covered, and two distinct exact critical-scale profiles describe how a positive odd-cycle gap collapses while an even-cycle zero persists. These are meaningful finite-bandwidth operator properties, not a one-off numerical parameter fact.
